content: Qa7aate Zarkketa Ooso
GODAY Musessinne Aaroones hizgides,
«Lewe nayta giddofe Qa7aate zareta istta soo asaan asaan istta mata dabbon dabbon qooda.
Gaytoteththa dunkaanezan ooththanaas dandayzayta, istta layththi heedzdzu tammaafe biidi ichchashu tammu gakkanaas diza attumasata ubbaa mazgaba.
Istti ooththana oosoy Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza giddon diza ubbaafe dumma geeshsha miishshata naago gidana.
Asay ba dizasoppe dendi bishin Aarooneynne iza nayti dunkaanezan gelidi Caaqo Qaala Taabotaza sinththan diza magalashaa duge woththidi Caaqo Qaala Taabotaza izan xaaxetto.
Iza kammanaas qaacettida galbaa magalashaza bollara woththidi hessa bolla mulera salo mala kareththa may7o iza bolla miccidi mayzetto; histtidi tooho miththata qalabate lukozan gelththetto.

«GODAAS shiiqiza dumma ukeththaa iza bolla woththiza gabateza salo misatiza kareththa carqqan kammetto; Gabateza bolla shel7eta, Cilfata, xuu7atanne woyne ushshu duuqqiza miishshatanne uketh ubba wode pacey baynda iza bolla woththetto.
Hessa ubbaa zo7o carqqan kammidi bollara qaacettida galba mayzetto; isttan tookkiza tooho miththata qalabate lukozan gelththetto.
«Salo misatiza kareththa carqqaza ekkidi xomppe iza bolla woththizayssanne xomppeta, qaphetanne bidinth woththiza kon7ata, hessaththoka zayte woththiza miishshata ubbaa issi bolla kammetto.
Xomppezanne xomppezas koshshiza miishshata ubbaaka iza kammiza galban xaaxidi izara tookkiza halaa bolla woththetto.
«Kaaleththidi worqqafe oosettida yarsho yarshizayssa bolla salo misatiza carqqan kammidi qaacettida galbaa bollara mayzidi tooho miththata izan gelththetto.
Gaytoteththa Dunkaanen go7ettiza miishshata ubbaa ekkidi salo mala kareththa carqqan kammetto; qaacettida lee7e galba iza bollara kammidi tooho miththaa bolla woththetto.
Bidinththaza yarsho yarshizasoza bollafe pittidi yarsho yarshizasoza ochcha teera misatiza carqqan kammetto.

Yarsho yarshizasozan ooththanaas go7ettiza miishshata heytikka hulaleta, menxota, tama kaashiza miishshatanne guuqa saaneta iza bolla woththetto; qaacettida lee7e galba iza bolla kammidi tooho miththata izan gelththetto.

Istti ba diza heeraappe dendi bishin Aarooneynne iza nayti geeshsha miishshatanne he miishshati isttan go7ettiza miishshata ubbaaka kammidaappe guye Qa7aate nayti yiidi tooketto; gido attiin istti hayqqontta mala he geeshsha miishshata kushen bochchanaas bessenna; hessa gishshas Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezi dendiza wode hessi wurikka Qa7aate nayta alaafeteththa.

«Qeeseza Aaroone naa El7ezeerey xomppeza zayte lo7o sawo sawiza exaane, ubba wode shiiqiza kaththa yarshozaninne tiyettiza zayteza bolla izas alaafeteththi de7o; hessaththoka Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezanne iza giddonkka diza geeshsha miishshata ubbaa naago.»
GODAY Musenne Aaroone hizgides,
«Qa7aate nayti Lewe qommota giddofe dhayana mala ooththofte.
Gede ubbaafe dumma geeshsha miishshatakko shiiqidi istti hayqqontta mala istta Aarooneynne iza nayti Gaytoteththa Dunkaanen gelidi asaas issaas issaas oosonne izaade tooho shaakki immetto.
Gido attiin istti hayqqontta mala Qa7aate nayti Dunkaaneza giddo gelidi beyanaas guuththa wodeska xeellopetto.»
Gershoone Zarkketa Ooso
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Lewe zarkketa garsafe Gershoone nayta istta dabbon dabboninne istta yeletan yeletan qooda.
Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezan ooththanaas dandayzayta heedzdzu tammu layththafe biidi ichchashu tammu layth gakkanaas diza attumasata ubbaa qooda.
«Dumma dumma miishshata tookkana alaafeteththi isttas dees.
Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza soo baggaranne kare baggara kammiza bollarakka iza bolla kammiza qaacettida lee7e galbaanne geloso pengezakka tookketto.

Hessaththoka Dunkaanezanne yarsho yarshosoho gibbeza yuuyi aadhdhida magalashata, tole wodorota, gibbe gelizaso penge magalashatanne heytantta ooththanaas giigettida miishshatakka istti tookketto; heyta he miishshatas gidiza ay oosokka istti poletto.
Gershoone nayti ooththiza ooso gidiin woykko tooho gidiin Aarooneynne iza nayti istta azazida mala ooththetto; istti tookkanaas bessiza miishshaa kumeth ne isttas gisha imma.
Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza giddon Gershoone nayta oosoy hessa; istta ooso qeese Aaroone naa Itamaarey xeelli oosiso.
Meraare Zarkketa Ooso
«Lewe zarkkefe gidida Meraare nayta istta zarkken zarkkeninne istta yeletan yeletan qooda.
Gaytoteththa Dunkaane giddon ooththanaas dandayzayta isttas layththay 30 layththafe biidi 50 layth gakkanaas diza attumasata ubbaa qooda.
Istti tookkanaas bessizay Dunkaaneza toletanne toleta giddora gelizayta, tuussata; Dunkaanezi izan tolettiza miishshata.

Hessaththoka Dunkaaneza yuushon diza demban eqqiza tuussata tohota; toleta wodorotanne heyta ubbatas koshshiza miishshata; issi issi asi tookkanaas bessiza miishshay iza sunththan sunththan izas utto.
Qeese Aaroone naa Itamaarey oosoza naagetti oosisanaas Gaytoteththa Dunkaane giddon Meraare nayta soo asaa oosoy hayssa.»
Lewe Zarkketa Qooda
Musey, Aarooneynne dereza halaqati Qa7aate zereththata istta zarkken zarkkeninne istta dabbon dabbon qoodida.
Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza giddon ooththanaas ooson gelidayta kumeth 30 layththafe biidi 50 layth gididayta qoodida.
Qoodettida asay 2,750 gidides.
GODAY kase Muse azazida mala Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezan ooththidayti Museynne Aarooney qoodida Qa7aate soo asay haytantta.
Ba zarkken zarkkeninne ba dabbon dabbon qoodettida Gershoone nayti,
Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezan ooththana gelanaas dandayzaytas layththay heedzdzu tammaafe biidi ichchashu tammu layth gakkanaas dizayti wurikka,
nam7u shiyanne usuppun xeetanne heedzdzu tamma.
GODAY Muse azazida mala Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezan ooththidaytinne Museynne Aarooney qoodida Gershoone nayti haytantta.
Ba zarkken zarkkeninne ba dabbon dabbon qoodettida Meraare nayti,
Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezan ooththana gelanaas dandayzaytas layththay heedzdzu tammaafe biidi ichchashu tammu layth gakkanaas dizayti wurikka,
heedzdzu shiyanne nam7u xeeta.
GODAY Muse azazida mala Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezan haggaziza Museynne Aarooney qoodida Meraare nayti haytantta.
Musey, Aarooneynne Isra7eele halaqati istta qommon qommoninne istta zarkken zarkken qoodida Lewe nayti,
heedzdzu tammu layththafe doommidi 50 layth gakkanaas dizayti Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza giddon oosoza ooththanaas ooththiza miishshata tookkanaas gelidayti,
mulera istta qooday 8,580.
Hessa malan issi issi asi GODAY Muse azazida mala qoodettides; hessaththoka GODAY Muses immida azazo mala issi issi asi tookkanaas alaafeteth ekkides.
